help.title: Fisher's Exact Test
help.body:
Description
Exact test of independence between two categorical variables, based on the hypergeometric distribution rather than the chi-square approximation. Use this instead of chi-square when expected cell counts are small (a common rule of thumb: any expected count < 5).

Requirements
• Both variables must be categorical (factors).
• For tables larger than 2x2, exact computation can be slow or infeasible — enable "Simulate p-value" to use Monte Carlo approximation instead.
• Odds ratio and confidence interval are only reported for 2x2 tables.

R function used: stats::fisher.test()
R Packages required: stats (base R — no install needed)
